plainLanguage: Section 65 regulates specified foreign enlistment, military/naval expedition and vessel-related conduct done without the President's licence.
meaning: Section 65 must be applied from its complete statutory wording, including any definitions, territorial conditions, licence requirements and prosecution safeguards.
keyPoints: The offence depends on one of the acts specifically listed in section 65.
Absence of the President's licence is an express condition.
The section distinguishes conduct involving citizens, foreign states at war with friendly states, expeditions and vessels.

legalTerms.meaning: Conduct involving foreign military/naval service or related activity as specifically regulated by section 65.

history.summary: Section 65 appears in Chapter VIII of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The exact statutory elements should be matched to evidence rather than inferred from the offence label.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Express licence, jurisdiction or prosecution-consent requirements are material to legal analysis.
